name: Migrate feedback without data loss
prompt: The supplied feedback.db has feedback(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,text TEXT NOT NULL,note TEXT NOT NULL). Implement python ingest.py --db feedback.db --input raw_feedback.json. Add category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'General' if missing; preserve all existing IDs/text/notes and classify existing and newly inserted rows. Classify case-insensitively by substring: any of error/crash/offline -> Technical; otherwise any of invoice/refund/charge -> Billing; otherwise General. Technical takes precedence. Insert new IDs from the input JSON array; for any existing ID, keep the original text/note. Re-running the same input must not duplicate/change rows or columns. Input records have unique integer IDs, text and note strings. Support fresh input files with new IDs and already existing IDs. Submit ingest.py; the evaluator starts from its own original database and supplies its own input paths. Do not edit/delete tests or other inputs.
